svg.title: ComfyUI-PulseStudio: names instead of ordinals, windows on the 17k+5 grid
svg.desc: (a) Three assets sit in sockets; the prompt references Mimi either by ordinal, <Picture 3>, or by name, @Mimi. When the sockets are reordered the ordinal points at the wrong asset while the name still resolves to Mimi. (b) Three render windows snap from their requested lengths (50, 103 and 69 frames) to the 17k+5 frame grid (56, 107, 73).
svg.text: (a) Reorder the sockets: the ordinal breaks, the name follows
window length in frames, quantised to 17k + 5
(b) Requested lengths (dashed) snap to the 17k + 5 frame grid
